basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Turku International Master's Scholarship & Finland Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Turku & Finnish Ministry of Education and Culture
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Turku Main Campus (Turku, Southwest Finland, Finland)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Faculty of Technology and Faculty of Science: Information and Communication Technology (Smart Systems, Cryptography and Data Security, Software Engineering), Mechanical Engineering, Molecular Biotechnology, and Physical and Chemical Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~120 to 160 full/partial tuition fee waivers and Finland Scholarships awarded annually across international Master's programs
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international merit competition; Pakistani computing and technology scholars secure ~10 to 16 scholarships annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years (full standard duration of 120 ECTS Master of Science program), renewal in year 2 contingent on completing minimum 45-55 ECTS in year 1
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: €5,000 one-time Finland Scholarship relocation grant (~PKR 1,500,000) + part-time campus research assistant earnings

nationality_requirements: Non-EU/EEA international citizens subject to Finnish university tuition fees (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction; candidates assessed on previous academic achievement and degree prerequisites.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor of Science / Engineering in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Telecommunications, or related STEM field (16 years education) with minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00 (or 75%+ marks) from an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum grade equivalent of Finnish grade 3.5 / 5.0 (Grade B+ on ECTS scale) in relevant technical studies.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial foundational coursework in programming languages, discrete mathematics, computer architecture, algorithms, and data security.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally with official provisional transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; practical experience in cybersecurity, robotics, or software development is viewed favorably.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 overall (minimum 5.5 in writing) or TOEFL iBT minimum 90 (minimum 20 in writing). Standardized test report is mandatory under Finnish university admissions criteria.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; academic degree programs are taught and examined 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply for the scholarship directly on Studyinfo.fi at the same time they apply for degree admission.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full Finnish government or university tuition scholarship concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver (worth €10,000 to €12,000 / year) for the entire 2-year duration of the Master of Science program.

admission_application_fee.details: Application on the official Finnish national portal Studyinfo.fi is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Subsidized student apartments arranged via Turku Student Village Foundation (TYS - Turun Ylioppilaskyläsäätiö); monthly rent €270 - €400 including heating, water, electricity, and 1 Gbps internet.

monthly_stipend.details: Finland Scholarship recipients receive an immediate €5,000 relocation grant disbursed into their Finnish bank account upon arrival. Departmental student assistantships (tutkimusavustaja) pay €12 - €16/hour for up to 20 hours/week.
monthly_stipend.amount: €5,000 one-time grant (~PKR 1,500,000) + part-time research assistant wages

airfare.details: International airfare to Helsinki/Turku arranged by student; covered by the €5,000 arrival grant.

visa_fee.details: Finnish Immigration Service (Migri) student residence permit electronic application fee (€350).

health_insurance.details: Private insurance policy (Swisscare/SIP ~€250/year) required for Migri residence permit; on campus, Finnish Student Health Service (FSHS / YTHS) provides full health care for ~€74/year.
health_insurance.amount: Private insurance ~€250/year; campus care via FSHS

food_allowance.details: State-subsidized Kela student lunches available across campus cafeterias (Assarin Ullakko, Tottisalmi) for €2.95 per meal.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full borrowing privileges at Feeniks University Library, computer laboratories, and specialized ICT research infrastructure.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Faculty travel grants available for Master's students co-authoring scientific publications presented at European research conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Föli (Turku Region Public Transport) offers 50% student discounts on monthly bus travel passes (~€38 / month).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single top-tier Finnish research university: University of Turku (Turun yliopisto).
participating_institutions: University of Turku (Main Campus, Turku, Finland)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Consistently ranked top 300 globally in QS World University Rankings; highly renowned in Europe for Information Security, Cryptography, and Biotechnology.
available_majors: Information and Communication Technology (Cryptography and Data Security)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree in relevant discipline, certified academic transcripts, motivation letter, CV, and standardized English test score (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: The Cryptography and Data Security track is world-renowned and attracts competitive applicants; strong discrete mathematics and network security foundations yield high evaluation scores.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: When completing your Studyinfo.fi application in January, simply check the box requesting the 'University of Turku Tuition Fee Scholarship / Finland Scholarship'—no separate scholarship dossier is needed.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Submit application on Studyinfo.fi during the annual January joint application window, select University of Turku degree programmes, opt-in for the scholarship, and upload digital document scans.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check prerequisite courses and prepare IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL (min 90) test scores.
Step 2: Submit application on Studyinfo.fi during the joint application period (early to mid-January).
Step 3: Select the checkbox requesting the University of Turku Scholarship and Finland Scholarship.
Step 4: Upload attested transcripts, degree certificates, CV, and motivational letter before the document deadline.
Step 5: Admissions committee reviews academic files and announces admission and scholarship results by late March or early April.
Step 6: Confirm acceptance of the study place and scholarship offer via Studyinfo.fi before the national deadline in July.
Step 7: Apply for Finnish residence permit for studies via Enter Finland (Migri) and book biometric appointment at VFS Global Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: Single application via Studyinfo.fi covers both degree admission and scholarship allocation.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Not required for general admission; only uploaded if specifically requested for interdisciplinary tracks.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Integrated motivation questions embedded within the online application addressing academic background, motivation, and career plans.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Summary of proposed Master's thesis focus in smart systems, cryptography, or software engineering.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV (Europass format preferred) detailing education, technical competencies, and software projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Evaluation is conducted based on documented academic credentials and motivation essay.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.5, writing 5.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 90, writing 20); GRE not required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Bachelor's degree and transcripts must be attested by HEC and MOFA Pakistan; Matric/Inter by IBCC.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation of all non-English documents.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Bachelor's Degree Certificate and Academic Transcripts
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for 4-year Bachelor's in CS/SE/Telecom with minimum CGPA 3.30/4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested copies from HEC and MOFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 6.5 overall, 5.5 writing) or TOEFL iBT (min 90, 20 writing).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Send electronic score report directly to University of Turku via testing agency.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed CV listing education, programming abilities, projects, and work experience.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Include links to GitHub and technical portfolios.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured motivation essay answering specific prompt questions on Studyinfo.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Emphasize alignment with Turku's cryptography, AI, or smart systems research.

required_documents_checklist.specification: High-resolution color scan of passport bio page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must be valid through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Finland conducts a unified nationwide Joint Application period in January. Missing the mid-January deadline means waiting an entire year.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (Undergraduate GPA and performance in core mathematical and computing courses)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (Undergraduate capstone project, publications, and technical depth)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Motivation letter quality and career goal clarity)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Faculty of Technology Academic Admissions Board at University of Turku.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Point-based scoring rubric evaluating degree relevance, GPA percentile, and motivation letter quality.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,500 to 2,200 international applicants across Faculty of Technology programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~120 to 160 full/partial tuition waivers and Finland Scholarships
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_global: ~8% to 11% for admission; ~4% to 6% for 100% full scholarship
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~6% to 9% among applicants with strong CGPA (3.4+) in computing and software
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.40+ / 4.00 from top Pakistani engineering institutions (NUST, FAST, GIKI, UET, NED)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates of accredited computing and engineering faculties with solid programming foundations and practical capstone projects.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani computer science, software engineering, and electronics departments.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Iran, China, Vietnam, Nigeria, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of fraudulent consultancy firms claiming to guarantee Finnish student visas or scholarships.
Applications must be filed exclusively through opintopolku.fi (Studyinfo.fi).
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Studyinfo.fi and University of Turku do NOT charge application fees for degree programs.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: University of Turku does not authorize agents to make admissions or scholarship decisions.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Finnish Migri residence permit electronic fee: €350 (~PKR 105,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You need to pay the first year tuition before getting the scholarship. Reality: The Finland Scholarship / Turku waiver is awarded directly in the admission letter and credited upfront.
Myth: You cannot work in Finland during studies. Reality: International students in Finland have the legal right to work up to 30 hours per week during term time.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial agencies suggest spring application deadlines; the actual Finnish Joint Application window closes strictly in mid-January.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must complete at least 45 to 55 ECTS credits during the first academic year to renew the tuition fee waiver for the second year.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time campus study and registration in Turku, Finland.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual transcript audit by the university registrar at the conclusion of spring semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work up to 30 hours per week under Finnish immigration law.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No return obligation; Finland grants a 2-year post-study job seeker residence permit upon graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bonds or repayment clauses.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is withdrawn if student drops out or fails to meet the ECTS progress threshold.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing major requires a new application in the subsequent joint application round.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship covers standard 2-year duration; third-year studies incur regular tuition fees unless special waiver granted.
